title: 2-D FFT
text: 计算二维快速傅里叶变换 (FFT)，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {FFT implementation} 指定FFT implementation；{Output in bit-reversed order} 指定 Bit-reversed output、{Scale result by FFT length} 指定 Scale output data、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 指定数据类型覆盖，按实例取值。

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 数据类型覆盖 off (default) | on
